purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Dandong city registry and natural-resources map portal are confirmed. The portal’s public layer menu contains general mapping services, not verified parcel polygons. No anonymous parcel feature schema or geometry was verified.
registryAssessment: Liaoning’s official provincial-government portal reports Dandong’s real-property registration center and its online application, appointment, record-query, and certificate-verification workflows. Dandong’s official natural-resources map portal identifies the Dandong Natural Resources Bureau as host. The map portal publishes generic vector/imagery/topographic/land-cover services; no cadastral parcel layer was listed.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Liaoning’s official provincial-government portal reports Dandong’s real-property registration center and its online application, appointment, record-query, and certificate-verification workflows. Dandong’s official natural-resources map portal identifies the Dandong Natural Resources Bureau as host. The map portal publishes generic vector/imagery/topographic/land-cover services; no cadastral parcel layer was listed.

The Dandong government’s e-registration announcement describes its city registry center and external online application/internal processing, including transfer, mortgage and alteration registration. The city-hosted Tianditu page identifies Dandong Natural Resources Bureau and offers vector base map, satellite imagery, terrain, land cover and hillshade. These are map-display products; no cadastral parcel layer or feature schema appears in the page’s published service list. No registration, property or owner lookup was performed.
